schema_note: the schema name is kept from Phase 2 on purpose: same field names, so the two archives are read by the same eyes and the same scripts. 2.0.0 generalises it beyond Phase 2 and adds the upload/download byte comparison to `verified`, per the 2026-08-20 ruling.
what: the 15,432 raw captures of the location sweep's step 1 negative control, held outside the repository
why: 121 MB of loose captures in a public repository is permanent weight; the index, the verdict, the reading, the four candidate FARs and all sixteen positive controls are committed, and this names the rest

archive.name: location_sweep_step1_2026_08_20.tar.zst
archive.deterministic: rebuilt byte-identically from the same inputs, digest compared

copies_caveat: only one local copy was made this time, deliberately: Phase 2's two local copies were on one filesystem and were therefore two files rather than two stores. The off-box copy that makes this archive survive the loss of this machine is the release asset listed first.

verified.method: rebuilt and digest-compared for determinism; extracted and every member sha256-compared against the file in the tree; re-extracted under the same relative layout the child argv records, so validate_index() could be re-run in full; every capture-recorded tcl_sha256 compared against the extracted script; then the release asset downloaded back over the network and `cmp`-compared byte for byte against the local archive. Only after all five did the loose files move.
verified.order: archive -> verify by extraction -> validate_index -> upload/download byte comparison -> move

kept_in_repository.intended_far_and_neighbours: far_00400a20..a23, each as capture + child log + Tcl (12 files) -- unlike Phase 2's, these four have their Tcl too
kept_in_repository.positive_controls: all sixteen, each as capture + child log + Tcl (48 files), so the frames that license the verdict can be checked without unpacking the archive
kept_in_repository.why_the_tcl_too: a capture and its log can only attest the Tcl digest they record. Without the script itself a reader still has to extract the archive to see the sequence that was actually shifted

loose_files.checked_before_moving: all 15,432 members were sha256-compared against the extracted archive before anything moved; 0 missing, 0 differing

offbox_copy.note: release assets do not consume Git LFS bandwidth; the repository already carries 417 MB of LFS against a 1 GB/month allowance
